headline: Fuel prices jump: All four major petroleum products raised by Tk 20 per litre
summary: Diesel, octane, petrol, and kerosene hit their highest-ever retail prices as the government passes on mounting import costs to consumers.
details: The government has increased the prices of diesel, octane, petrol, and kerosene by Tk 20 per litre each, effective from 12:00 am today. This marks the biggest hike since August 2022 and takes all four products to their highest-ever retail prices.

New prices are: diesel at Tk 135, octane at Tk 165, petrol at Tk 160, and kerosene at Tk 155 per litre. Diesel, which is critical to the economy, is now 35% more expensive than it was before the US-Israel war on Iran.

The hike is driven by rising international petroleum prices and freight charges. The Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation (BPC) reported a loss of Tk 22,875 crore between March and August due to these mounting import costs.
According to the Energy Division, BPC was losing approximately Tk 89 on every litre of diesel sold before this adjustment, amounting to a daily loss of around Tk 109 crore.
The government estimates that this Tk 20 increase will reduce BPC's annual losses by approximately Tk 10,000 crore. However, BPC had proposed an even higher retail price of Tk 187 for diesel.
The economic impact is expected to be widespread as diesel accounts for 64% of total petroleum consumption, heavily used in transport (60%), agriculture (15%), and power generation (10%).
Higher diesel prices are likely to trigger a second-round impact on food and other consumer prices, as freight charges and distribution costs for goods increase.

headline: Case filed against MP Gazi Nazrul over second wife’s death
summary: The Satkhira-4 lawmaker's second wife was found dead in a Dhaka flat; the MP and his first wife are now being questioned by police.
details: A case has been filed against Satkhira-4 MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and two others on charges of abetting the death of his second wife, Mariam Khatun.
Mariam’s hanging body was recovered from a flat at NAM Bhaban in Dhaka last night.
The case was filed by Mariam’s father, Masum Billah, with the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station late Sunday night.
Along with the MP, his first wife, Maksuda Begum, and Mariam’s maternal uncle, Obaidur Rahman, have been named as accused in the case.
Police reported that Gazi Nazrul was present at the flat when the body was recovered.
The lawmaker and his first wife were subsequently taken to the police station for questioning.
Deputy Commissioner Mohammad Ibne Mizan of the Tejgaon Division stated that the MP has not been arrested due to legal procedures required for lawmakers.
Police are continuing their investigation into the circumstances surrounding the death.
caption:
A Satkhira-4 MP and his first wife are being questioned after his second wife was found dead in a Dhaka flat.

Mariam’s hanging body was recovered from a flat at NAM Bhaban in Dhaka last night.

The case was filed by Mariam’s father, Masum Billah, with the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station late Sunday night.

Along with the MP, his first wife, Maksuda Begum, and Mariam’s maternal uncle, Obaidur Rahman, have been named as accused in the case.

Police reported that Gazi Nazrul was present at the flat when the body was recovered.

The lawmaker and his first wife were subsequently taken to the police station for questioning.

Deputy Commissioner Mohammad Ibne Mizan of the Tejgaon Division stated that the MP has not been arrested due to legal procedures required for lawmakers.

Police are continuing their investigation into the circumstances surrounding the death.
